missing: CER-001 human engagement: Kootte 2015 J Lipid Res doi:10.1194/jlr.M055665 (FHA patients, efflux +44%, cholesterol mobilization) - a same entry on the mouse-cer001 engagement track.

Rabbit IVUS/MRI track for apoA-I Milano/POPC: Parolini 2008 JACC doi:10.1016/j.jacc.2007.12.010 (ETC-216 regressed rabbit carotid atheroma on IVUS, dose guidance); a retrodiction of Nissen 2003 and a prospective prediction for MILANO-PILOT efficacy (and possibly dose).

MILANO-PILOT failure public 2016-11-15: Cleveland Clinic release https://newsroom.clevelandclinic.org/2016/11/15/cleveland-clinic-researchers-find-no-benefit-hdl-raising-injection-regression-coronary-heart-disease and MedCo discontinuation (firstwordpharma.com/story/4261668).

Human genetic track (not verified): ApoA-I Milano carriers (Sirtori 2001 Circulation, Limone sul Garda study) cited by Kallend 2016 as the basis for the class; a human_genetic model compared with MILANO-PILOT.
Ex vivo human plasma/whole-blood CSL112 efflux (Diditchenko 2013, same paper) is a separate ex_vivo system from the rabbit; could be its own engagement track paired with Gille 2014.
If 'apolipoprotein a-i' includes CSL111 (plasma-derived apoA-I/soy PC): ERASE (Tardif 2007 JAMA, doi:10.1001/jama.297.15.jama70004) failed its placebo-controlled IVUS primary; not verified here.

Ex vivo MDCO-216 serum incubation track: Kempen 2014 (doi:10.1155/2014/923903, epub 2014-11-12) MDCO-216 in human serum potentiated ABCA1 efflux; paired with Kallend 2016 it is a retro engagement entry (post-dates Patel 2009).
rule_questions: MILANO-PILOT concludes no incremental regression 'in the setting of contemporary statin therapy'; the apoE-/- mice were never on statins. Does that framing count as the trial attributing the result to a condition the model never tested (-> untested) or is it background (-> contra)?
Does ETC-216 (Esperion apoA-I Milano/POPC, older manufacturing with host-cell proteins) score as the member MDCO-216, or is it a different product outside the class list?
Is a sponsor/academic press release or congress presentation date admissible for an entry's year when the dating rule lists registry, epub, label and print only?
Which drug(s) does the member 'apolipoprotein a-i' denote: CSL112 only, or also CSL111?
models: a human genetic model that predicted NO benefit (Haase 2010 APOA1 variants) and that the class did not rely on - is it admissible as a track, and is a null-matches-null pairing scored 'same'?
models: MILANO-PILOT attributes its null to 'the setting of contemporary statin therapy', a condition neither the rabbit nor the carrier model tested - contra or untested (efficacy 9, 12)?

Safety 2: Reijers 2017 imports a no-immunostimulation result from HV/sCAD while MILANO-PILOT measured ACS patient safety; does 'this disease's patients set the status' apply to a predicted absence of harm?
